_note: Conventions as commonly published in each ISO's public price reports. status=verify_before_use: confirm against the ISO's current report specification for the exact report you load. Edit here, not in code.

CAISO.native_timestamp: OASIS INTERVALSTARTTIME_GMT / INTERVALENDTIME_GMT (UTC); local reports use hour-ending in Pacific prevailing time
CAISO.notes: LMP = energy (MCE) + congestion (MCC) + loss (MCL) + GHG (MGHG, WEIM). Real-time has 15-minute FMM and 5-minute RTD markets.

ERCOT.native_timestamp: DeliveryDate + HourEnding (01:00-24:00) [+ DeliveryInterval 1-4] + DSTFlag (Y on the repeated fall-back hour), Central prevailing time
ERCOT.notes: Settlement Point Prices (SPP) at resource nodes, hubs and load zones. RT SPP is a 15-minute time-weighted value of 5-minute SCED LMPs plus real-time adders (ORDC reserve price adder, reliability deployment adder). No marginal loss component in ERCOT nodal prices. SCED bus LMPs are not settlement prices.

PJM.notes: total_lmp = system_energy_price + congestion_price + marginal_loss_price. Five-minute real-time settlement since 2021-02-01; hourly RT LMPs are integrated values.

MISO.native_timestamp: Market date + hour ending (HE1-HE24) in Eastern Standard Time year-round (no DST)
MISO.notes: Reports LMP, MCC (congestion) and MLC (loss); energy = LMP - MCC - MLC. EST all year: summer hours are offset one hour from Eastern prevailing time.

NYISO.native_timestamp: Time Stamp in Eastern prevailing time (check per report whether it marks interval start or end)
NYISO.notes: LBMP = energy + losses - published congestion component (published Marginal Cost Congestion is the negative of the shift-factor-weighted shadow prices). A negative published congestion value RAISES the price.

ISONE.native_timestamp: Date + Hour Ending (01-24, repeated fall-back hour labelled 02X) in Eastern prevailing time
ISONE.notes: LMP = energy + congestion + loss. Five-minute real-time settlement (sub-hourly settlement) since 2017.

SPP.native_timestamp: GMTIntervalEnd (UTC, interval ending); also Interval in Central prevailing time
